llm.relevance_to_user: 本文直接研究线弧增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的热输入对微观组织和力学性能的影响，与L1层的力学与疲劳性能评估高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on tensile properties and microstructure but does not include fatigue testing or S-N curve data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热输入对线弧增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金微观组织和力学性能的影响规律。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同热输入参数进行线弧增材制造，并检测试样微观组织和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 发现了热输入对晶粒尺寸、相组成及拉伸性能的显著影响，并确定了最优工艺窗口。
summary_zh.validation: 通过金相观察、拉伸测试和硬度测量进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how varying heat input affects the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy fabricated by wire arc additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated with different heat input levels and characterized using optical microscopy, SEM, tensile tests, and hardness measurements.
summary_en.result: Heat input significantly influenced grain morphology, phase fractions, and mechanical performance; an optimal heat input range was identified for balanced properties.
summary_en.validation: Experimental data from microstructural analysis and mechanical testing validate the findings.

papers.title: An Integrated Experimental and Simulation Study on Residual Stress and Fatigue Life of TC4 Alloy Subjected to Cold Expansion and Reaming
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Titanium alloys, notably TC4 (Ti‐6Al‐4V), are critical for aerospace structural components, yet fastener holes within them serve as stress concentration sites prone to fatigue crack initiation. Cold expansion strengthening is a prevalent technique to enhance fatigue life by introducing beneficial compressive residual stresses around these holes. This study systematically investigates the influence of two core process parameters—expansion amount and reaming depth—on the resultant residual stress field and fatigue life enhancement in TC4 alloy. A combined approach of experimental testing and finite element simulation using ABAQUS was employed. The results elucidate that increasing the expansion amount elevates both tangential and radial residual stresses, significantly improving fatigue life; however, excessive expansion induces material damage. Conversely, while reaming improves surface integrity, excessive reaming diminishes the compressive residual stress layer, thereby reducing the fatigue benefit. Optimal parameter combinations were identified for typical structures (A40 and A50), achieving a maximum fatigue life improvement of up to 30 times compared with untreated specimens. This research provides optimized process guidelines and a deeper understanding of the parameter interactions for cold expansion in critical aerospace applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究TC4钛合金冷扩孔和铰孔后处理工艺对疲劳寿命的影响，与方向2完全匹配。
llm.why_not_core: 无，该论文完全符合方向2的要求。

summary_zh.motivation: 优化冷扩孔和铰孔参数以提高TC4合金紧固孔疲劳寿命。
summary_zh.method: 结合疲劳试验与ABAQUS有限元模拟，分析扩孔量和铰孔深度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 最优参数组合使疲劳寿命提升多达30倍，过量扩孔或铰孔会降低效果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳试验与未处理试样对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize cold expansion and reaming parameters for enhancing fatigue life of TC4 alloy fastener holes.
summary_en.method: Experimental fatigue tests and finite element simulations via ABAQUS were used to investigate the effects of expansion amount and reaming depth on residual stress and fatigue life.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameter combinations achieved up to 30× improvement in fatigue life, while excessive expansion or reaming diminished the benefit.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing fatigue test results of treated specimens with untreated ones.
